items.notes: The integration and use-case guides now define lotus-performance ownership of analytics truth and lotus-ai ownership of explanation generation, audit, and support review posture.
The service runbook now documents limited-rollout review, rollback-to-blocked posture, and the requirement to stop downstream exposure when first-use-case governance is no longer ready.

Operators now have an explicit first-use-case path for inspecting runtime readiness, audit traces, observability incident summaries, and bounded artifact descriptors when commentary or input-shape incidents occur.
Unsupported or incomplete analytics inputs are now treated as a distinct support and rollback review path rather than normal explanation variance.
